items.content_html: A lightweight web-based tool for estimating the shift of the oxyhaemoglobin dissociation curve (ODC) in preterm infants based on SpO₂–PiO₂ measurements. Built for clinical research and potential bedside use, this platform features a Flask backend for real-time prediction and a React frontend for user interaction.

items.content_html: A lightweight, interactive web project built for fun and practice with the HTML5 element. On each click, it generates animated, randomized paths that mimic the structure of hexagons. This experiment explores grid-based drawing, recursion, and dynamic rendering logic using raw JavaScript — no frameworks, just the canvas API and imagination.
